cold_email.subject: Interest in Sr Associate Software Engineer Full Stack — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Sr Associate Software Engineer Full Stack opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.description: Career Category Engineering Job Description Software Engineer, Full Stack — Decision Intelligence ABOUT AMGEN Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today. The opportunity Amgen’s AI & Data Science team is building decision-intelligence products that help teams make faster, more defensible decisions under uncertainty. We are seeking a Software Engineer, Decision Intelligence to join the Forecasting & Decision Intelligence team within the AI & Data organization. This role will help develop scenario-planning capabilities—including visualization, capacity, and AI-assisted decision workflows—while contributing to reusable foundations for forecasting, simulation, optimization, and decision products across the enterprise. We are seeking a Full-Stack Engineer who can build high-quality product experiences across the frontend and backend. You will develop the interfaces people use to configure, launch, monitor, compare, and understand complex scenarios, as well as the APIs, data integrations, and execution services that make those experiences trustworthy. Basic qualifications · Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. · 5+ years of professional software-engineering experience building and supporting production applications. · Full-stack engineering experience, including modern frontend development with React and TypeScript and backend API development with Python or another modern server-side language. · Experience building usable, data-rich web applications in partnership with product, design, and business stakeholders. · Experience with relational SQL and data-intensive applications, including integration with warehouse, lakehouse, or operational data systems. · Familiarity with asynchronous processing, queues, workflow engines, or similar patterns for long-running workloads. · Experience with cloud deployment, containers, CI/CD, automated testing, and production troubleshooting. · Commitment to code quality, accessibility, documentation, observability, and operational ownership. Preferred qualifications · Experience with FastAPI, Databricks, Spark, Kubernetes, modular frontend architectures, or comparable technologies. · Experience building interactive visualizations and comparison workflows for analytical, operational, financial, or planning users. · Experience embedding statistical models, optimization engines, simulation, or machine-learning capabilities into production applications. · Experience with API and data-contract versioning, enterprise identity and access management, and secure integrations. · Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, healthcare, finance, or another complex operational domain. · Familiarity with AI-assisted product experiences and appropriate grounding, evaluation, and human-review controls. .

jobs.description: Job Title: Utilities & Energy Engineer Engineering, Commissioning, Reliability & Energy Performance Role Purpose We are seeking a highly motivated Utilities & Energy Engineer to support the operation, optimisation, commissioning, and continuous improvement of site utility systems. The role will focus on the reliable and efficient operation of critical utilities, including chilled water, steam and condensate, compressed air, HVAC, Critical utilities including Clean Steam and Pharmaceutical Water Systems, and associated distribution networks. The successful candidate will drive troubleshooting activities, support capital projects from design through commissioning and handover, drive reliability improvements, and identify energy optimisation opportunities across site utility assets. Energy performance will be embedded within sound engineering, operational excellence, and lifecycle management. Main Responsibilities Utilities Engineering & Operations • Provide engineering support for site utility systems, including chilled water, steam and condensate, compressed air, HVAC, water systems, and heat recovery systems to allow efficient energy optimization of these systems. • Monitor system performance, capacity, and operating parameters to identify reliability, efficiency, and Energy improvements. • Lead technical troubleshooting and root-cause investigations for utility equipment failures and Energy performance issues. • Work with operations and maintenance teams to resolve recurring equipment energy performance issues. • Develop engineering solutions that improve utility system resilience, controllability, and energy performance. • Review operating strategies and setpoints to reduce energy use, emissions and operating costs without compromising system reliability. Commissioning & Project Delivery • Lead and support energy projects from concept development and design review through installation, commissioning, start-up, and handover. • Develop engineering scopes, technical specifications and equipment requirements • Review contractor designs, calculations, drawings, method statements, and vendor documentation. • Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and system commissioning activities. • Execute commissioning plans, test scripts, punch lists, and handover documentation. • Support qualification activities and change control processes where required. Reliability & Continuous Improvement • Identify Energy & Reliability improvement opportunities for all Utilities and HVAC systems • Support asset lifecycle planning, obsolescence reviews, and replacement strategies. • Use performance data, failure history, and condition monitoring to improve asset availability. • Lead or support continuous improvement initiatives focused on energy efficiency and operational excellence. • Develop and maintain utility engineering standards, operating procedures and technical guidance. Energy Performance & Digital Systems • Monitor utility consumption, equipment efficiency, and system performance trends. • Identify and develop energy-saving opportunities through engineering analysis and operational optimisation. • Support implementation and commissioning of utility metering, monitoring and control systems. • Use BMS, SCADA, EMS, Power BI, and other digital tools to analyse performance and support decision-making. • Develop clear dashboards and reports for utility performance, reliability and project benefits. Safety, Quality & General Responsibilities • Ensure engineering activities comply with site safety, quality, and engineering standards. • Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, management of change, and project governance meetings. • Coordinate effectively with site teams, contractors, vendors, and alliance partners. • Undertake other relevant activities as directed by the Veolia Contract Manager. Required Qualifications & Experience • Degree, diploma or equivalent qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, Process, Energy or Chemical Engineering, or related discipline. • Typically, 3 to 5+ years of experience in industrial utilities, facilities engineering, energy engineering, or process engineering. • Strong working knowledge of industrial utility systems and associated equipment. • Experience delivering CAPEX and OPEX engineering projects. • Experience commissioning industrial equipment and utility systems. • Demonstrated troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and technical problem-solving capability. • Ability to interpret drawings, specifications, control narratives, performance data, and vendor documentation. Desirable Experience • Experience within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or other regulated manufacturing environment. • Knowledge of chillers, cooling towers, boilers, heat exchangers, compressors, pumps, HVAC and heat recovery systems. • Experience with CMMS, BMS, SCADA, EMS, data historians, or digital reporting platforms. • Experience supporting utility qualification, commissioning documentation or change control. • Energy management experience is advantageous, with the emphasis on practical engineering optimisation. Key Competencies Engineering & Technical Delivery & Collaboration · Utilities systems engineering · Commissioning and start-up · Equipment reliability and lifecycle planning · Root-cause analysis · Performance and energy optimisation · Technical data analysis · Project and contractor management · Strong planning and organisation · Clear technical communication · Cross-functional collaboration · Stakeholder management · Continuous improvement mindset Key Interfaces • Internal: Utilities Operations, Maintenance, Calibration, Planning, Engineering Technical Services, Energy Team, Projects, Quality and EHS. • External: Equipment vendors, specialist contractors, consultants and Veolia alliance partners. Measures of Success • High reliability, availability, and resilience of site utility systems. • Safe and effective commissioning, start-up and handover of utility projects. • Projects delivered to agreed scope, schedule, quality and budget. • Improved utility system performance, energy efficiency and operating cost. • Clear technical ownership and timely resolution of operational issues. • Improved utility capacity management, asset lifecycle planning, and data visibility. jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description: ABOUT WATERSHED Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us! THE ROLE Watershed is seeking an experienced Accounting Manager to own our global general ledger accounting, financial close, and audit preparation as we scale. This role will be responsible for accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and full audit cycle execution. You'll also directly manage and mentor accounting team members as our accounting team grows. This is a US GAAP-based role supporting our global, consolidated reporting; knowledge of Mexican statutory/monthly reporting requirements or UK GAAP is a plus, not a requirement. As Accounting Manager, you'll be the engine behind our financial close process and the point person for audit execution and statutory compliance across all Watershed entities and geographies. You'll own complex technical accounting areas including lease accounting, equity transactions, and tax compliance, while building scalable processes and controls to support our ambitious growth trajectory. Working closely with our Technical Accounting team, external auditors, and cross-functional partners, you'll ensure our financial reporting is accurate, timely, and audit-ready. This is an exceptional opportunity for someone who thrives in high-growth environments, loves building systems and processes from the ground up, and wants to make a meaningful impact on both our business and global climate action. WHAT YOU'LL DO GL Management & Financial Close - Manage the global general ledger, chart of accounts, and intercompany accounting. - Lead and mentor a growing accounting team, providing technical review and coaching, and building a high-performing, inclusive team dynamic that thrives in a fast-paced environment. - Drive the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process end-to-end across all Watershed entities and geographies, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness. - Own a portfolio of accounts through close, reconciliations, and journal entries. - Prepare and own US GAAP financial statements, including building the cash flow statements from the ground up. - Perform flux analysis, explaining period-over-period movements across the balance sheet and income statement. - Own investor and board-level financial reporting. - Architect our group-level intercompany framework, elimination logic, transaction-flow documentation, and sources of truth, designed to absorb new entities and future acquisitions. - Streamline our intercompany cost-sharing arrangements (pay-on-behalf-of / collect-on-behalf-of) and redesign and automate the cost-allocation process. Audit, Technical Accounting & Compliance - Serve as primary point person for external audits, preparing comprehensive documentation (PBC lists, workpapers, flowcharts, walkthroughs) and coordinating all audit activities, ensuring deliverables are consistently audit-ready with clear supporting evidence. - Apply technical US GAAP guidance in key areas including allocations, cashflow, carbon credit accounting, COGS, fixed-assets, FX, lease accounting, and stock-based compensation. - Take ownership of tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions and coordinate with external advisors. - Manage the accounting and reporting requirements for unique legal entities, including consolidation assessments and entity-level reporting. Process Innovation, Technology & Cross-Functional Partnership - Co-own our ERP system with our Finance Systems leads, partnering on configuration, controls, and platform decisions as the accounting function's needs evolve. - Act as a tech-forward accounting partner, identifying opportunities to automate tasks through ERP features, AI tools, or emerging technologies, and translating ambiguous business needs into scalable accounting and operational frameworks. - Identify bottlenecks in current processes and implement solutions, if something is manual and time-consuming, redesign or automate it. - Support ad-hoc projects such as system implementations, new business or entity launches, data quality enhancements, or technical accounting research. - Partner with Technical Accounting, FP&A, Legal, People, and Operations teams to support business initiatives and provide accounting guidance across the organization. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE: - 8+ years of progressive accounting experience in SaaS or tech companies, with demonstrated experience leading audit preparation and execution. Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus. - Deep proficiency in US GAAP with hands-on technical accounting experience including cash flow preparation. - Strong experience with financial close and multi-entity/global GL management and accounting. - Deep working knowledge of ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, Rillet), advanced Excel/Google Sheets experience, and a proven track record of using AI tools to eliminate low-value accounting work. - Experience building, managing and mentoring high performing, diverse teams that thrive in a fast paced environment. - Exceptional ability to work independently, thrive in ambiguity, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complex accounting positions into plain language for non-accounting partners. - Knowledge of Mexican statutory accounting (SAT compliance) and/or UK GAAP is a plus. - Fluency in English is required. - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, plus CPA, CPC (Contador Público Certificado), or an international equivalent preferred. Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles) Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so. What’s the interview process like? It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process. What if I need accommodations for my interview? At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Codex
jobs.description: About the team The Applied AI Engineering team helps enterprises put Codex to work on their most important engineering workflows. We work alongside customer engineers to turn frontier AI capabilities into systems that improve how software is built, shipped, secured, and operated. Our work spans unfamiliar codebases, legacy systems, data pipelines, infrastructure, and enterprise integrations. We discover where AI can make a meaningful difference, build and prove solutions, and turn what we learn into reusable architectures, tools, and feedback that help shape Codex. About the Role We’re looking for an engineer who enjoys understanding complex systems, building alongside customers, and solving problems where the path forward isn’t obvious. You’ll work directly with technical leaders and engineers to identify valuable opportunities and take them from discovery through implementation and evaluation. You might build a Codex-assisted release review workflow, modernize a legacy data pipeline, accelerate a dependency migration, or connect an agent to the systems and context it needs to investigate production incidents. You’ll combine hands-on software engineering, architecture, and technical leadership to make Codex part of how customers get important work done. Success means delivering the agreed solution, demonstrating measurable improvement, and helping the customer sustain and expand its use. Working with our product, engineering, research, and account teams, you’ll turn deployment experience into evidence that informs improvements to Codex. The position is based in Sydney, Australia, with three office days each week. Relocation assistance is available to new employees. In this role, you will: - Lead customer engineering engagements from workflow discovery and architecture through implementation, evaluation, and handoff, with clear customer owners, delivery milestones, and measurable success criteria. - Assess customer repositories, data systems, infrastructure, security controls, and development practices to understand constraints, determine readiness, and identify where Codex can have the greatest impact. - Build and validate workflows alongside customer engineers, developing integrations, tool gateways, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, and automations, often using Codex in your own development process. - Establish baselines, quality and security guardrails, and evaluation methods that demonstrate whether a workflow is reliable, useful, and ready to expand. - Turn customer engagements into reusable tools, architectures, and deployment patterns, and translate recurring challenges into actionable feedback for product, engineering, and research teams. - Document technical decisions and results for handoff and reuse, establishing clear customer, partner, or delivery-team ownership for production release, ongoing operation, and maintenance. - Use evidence to recommend when to expand a workflow, redirect an engagement, or stop work when value or feasibility cannot be demonstrated. You’ll thrive in this role if you: - Have 5+ years of relevant experience in software development, deployment engineering, data or infrastructure engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture. - Can build, debug, and evaluate production-relevant software and quickly understand unfamiliar systems. - Actively use AI coding tools, have adapted them to your own work, and have a clear perspective on how agents can automate complete workflows. - Bring technical depth in one or more areas, such as software engineering, data systems, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise integrations, and enjoy learning across disciplines. - Understand how software is tested, released, and operated, and can reason about the security, reliability, and access requirements of enterprise environments. - Can turn an ambiguous customer problem into a practical technical plan with credible estimates, measurable acceptance criteria, and clear tradeoffs. - Communicate effectively with technical leaders and hands-on engineers, collaborate through uncertainty, and turn individual customer work into solutions others can reuse.
